About us

Building the operating system for D2C growth.

We believe growing an e-commerce business shouldn't mean managing hundreds of tasks, tools and disconnected systems.

ARINE brings research, marketing, operations, analytics and business intelligence together into one ecosystem, helping founders spend less time managing and more time growing.

Our story

We saw a problem. So we built a solution.

After working with 150+ D2C brands and managing 1,500+ marketing campaigns, from emerging startups to enterprise e-commerce businesses, we started noticing a pattern.

Many promising brands reached a certain stage and struggled to grow further. Some early-stage D2C businesses even struggled to survive their first 6 to 8 months.

The problem wasn't always the product. It wasn't necessarily the market or the audience. The problem was the absence of a system.

Connected system

The missing piece we set out to build.

The pattern

Founders were stuck in repetitive work.

In the middle of all this, something important was getting neglected: the founder's ability to understand the business, analyse performance and make the right decisions.

Managing marketing campaigns and advertisingHandling operations and customer relationshipsFinding and managing the right peopleTracking finances and business performanceSwitching between multiple software and reporting toolsCoordinating different teams and business functions

Businesses didn't just need another tool to perform individual tasks. They needed an integrated system that could connect different functions, understand business performance and help them make better decisions. That's where ARINE began.

What we are building

Meet ARINE. Your D2C Growth Operating System.

ARINE is built to work alongside your business, from understanding your market and products to executing growth strategies, monitoring performance and identifying opportunities. One platform. One source of truth. One system to grow.

Research

Markets, products and competitors.

Plan and execute

Marketing strategies, from idea to launch.

Automate

Advertising and repetitive workflows.

Monitor

Sales, performance and business metrics.

Understand customers

Behaviour and funnel performance.

Find opportunities

Spot them and recommend improvements.

Instead of switching between fragmented tools and manually compiling reports, founders get a connected view of their business and actionable insights to move forward.

Our philosophy

Founders should focus on decisions, not repetitive tasks.

We believe technology should simplify business, not make it more complicated. A founder shouldn't have to spend hours collecting numbers, switching dashboards or coordinating repetitive activities just to understand what's happening in their business.

We want to give founders the infrastructure, intelligence and automation they need to build sustainable businesses.

Our journey

From experience to an ecosystem.

The BeginningSeptember 2025
ARINE began with a vision to solve the operational and growth challenges faced by D2C businesses.
Understanding the Gaps

A message from the founder

Hi, I'm Aarush, the founder of ARINE Ecosystem. I have spent most of my professional journey understanding D2C businesses, e-commerce marketing and what actually drives growth.

Having worked on more than 1,500 marketing campaigns and alongside 150+ D2C brands, I've experienced the challenges businesses face at different stages of growth. One thing became increasingly clear to me: businesses don't struggle only because of a lack of marketing or resources. They struggle because everything operates in silos.

I started ARINE with the intention of changing that. I wanted to build something that goes beyond automating individual tasks: a system that understands how a business operates, connects its data, helps identify opportunities and makes decision-making easier.

We are still building, learning and improving every day. And our vision remains the same: to stand alongside D2C founders as a technology and growth partner.

Our vision

An ecosystem for every e-commerce business that plans to grow.

We envision a future where businesses don't need dozens of disconnected tools and manual processes to operate. Where technology understands the business, automation handles repetitive work, and founders have the clarity to make better decisions.

Infrastructure built for those who plan to grow.
